cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You put a cushion on the chair, so I added one. Our invisible dinner guest will be comfortable. Will you introduce Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's wet from the wash. That seat's damp now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Drying first, yes. Offer the guest the chair beside you and introduce Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair for Mum.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies cushion placement as comfort but B drying makes seat unusable; A3 pretends orderly preparation and recruits guest relocation; A5 makes B treat invisible guest as occupying a seat.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wet seat causes A3 different chair; B4 Mum need causes A5 additional chair rather than displacement.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects against damp seat and B4 attends Mum actual comfort.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 collision to normalize equal courtesy for unseen guest.

specificity.evidence: A1 invisible dinner guest/Mum and B2 damp seat establish unusual and ordinary constraints.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 fetch-another instruction enacts normalizing behavior without a lecture.
